description.value: Kozak is an authentic Ukrainian restaurant and cafe serving homemade Ukrainian food in Vancouver's Gastown neighbourhood. Located at 1 West Cordova Street, it offers indoor seating and online ordering, making it a distinctive stop for touring cyclists seeking hearty Eastern European cooking in the heart of the city.
